import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_34/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_34/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join to keep only matching cities)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by city and count ride_id occurrences
result = joined.groupby("city", as_index=False).agg({"ride_id": "count"})

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
result.columns = ["city", "ride_id"]

# Write output to the specified file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_34/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
